Using the power of the harmonic convergence gathered by Voracia the Dreaded, [[Characters/Gods/Betrayers/Arkonil]] the Wicked and his army of demons made war against the mortal plane through the Abyssal gates. A conflict spanning multiple planes that lasts 30 years. They were held back and eventually stopped by the warriors and mages of the Inheritor pact and through the binding magics of an unknown wizard Arkonil along with his generals were sealed within different items. This is considered to be the greatest alliance of moral powers in history.
